notes:
A native PDF engine: big plan sets flip faster and use far less memory.

- **Sheets draw with PDFium**, the PDF engine inside Chrome, in its own helper
  process. On a 62-sheet IFC set a typical sheet turn went from 0.6 s to 0.14 s,
  the heaviest sheet from 6 s to under 3 s, and memory while paging through the
  set from 4.5 GB to under 2 GB. Memory goes back as soon as you stop.
- **A picture of every sheet is made in the background** after a set opens and
  kept on disk, so the thumbnail strip fills in and any sheet has something to
  show while it draws.
- If the native engine is ever unavailable, sheets draw the way they did
  before — nothing to set up.
- **AI tools see exactly the app's figures.** A job saved by this build carries
  its own priced totals, and the MCP tools read those instead of working the
  money out a second time. Older jobs are still read as before; opening and
  saving one in the app upgrades it.

Third-party notices for the PDF engine are in the app's Resources folder
(nxg-render/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt).
